svg.aria-label: Expert architecture diagram of the USAXS software ecosystem: sample survey, instrument control via command line, GUI, and AI agent all driving one queue server, the data-reduction, analysis, and plotting pipeline that follows.
svg.text: USAXS / SAXS / WAXS Software Ecosystem — Expert Overview
APS 12-ID-E · control, sample survey, and data pipeline · September 2026
writes sample list directly into the queue
no beamline connection needed to lay out a plate
replays the whole .mac as one queued plan — from CLI, GUI, or Agent
Queue Server — RE Manager + RE Worker
headless — no typed console at all
runs the usaxs.startup plans, holds the live oregistry
the single control point the GUI and the agent both share
device I/O for every plan, from any interface
one record per scan, whichever interface ran it
polls Tiled every few seconds; calibrates,
matilda-gui — open a file, override blank,
plots SAS data now; will also plot
